drivers: Single Latin-square rule on rotation (each row/column has 135°, 180°, 90°) with count and fill held constant
Six of eight distractors change count or fill, which never vary in the grid, so they are eliminated at a glance
Only one competing option (E) shares count and fill, so the choice reduces to picking the missing rotation
Pentagon rotations of 90°/135°/180° must be visually discriminated, a minor perceptual demand under 60 s
